answer: One defense is lagoon quarantine with relic anchoring: every new identity starts in a lagoon, an isolated pool where it can work but earns no weight until its history is anchored to a relic, a long-lived, publicly audited record that takes real time to build and cannot be bought or forged. Standing then grows like a dune, grain by grain, only from verified jobs with unrelated counterparties. A sybil farmer must keep each fake working in the lagoon for the full waiting period, paying real time and compute per identity, while one honest agent anchors once.
